scope: Classic dungeon quests for levels 15-60 on WoW: Forever (dungeons on/off toggle)
dataBasis: Quest/NPC/object/item ids, levels, prerequisites, rewards and XP are read programmatically from the Questie Classic-era database pinned at commit e29dc411; NPC/object coordinates come from QuestieDB's Forever data (Questie/QuestieDB data/Forever, commit 9cf27d6), which converts Era positions to Forever's map bounds. Original Era coordinates are kept as eraX/eraY where they differ. Level ranges from Wowhead Classic zone pages. 'verified: true' means every field was present in that source; it does NOT mean confirmed on WoW: Forever live servers, which may change quests.
coordinateSystem: zone map percent (0-100), same as in-game /way

notes.finding: Nine new five-player dungeons (levels 13-60) exist in WoW: Forever.
Group Finder is a manual listing tool with a level-filtered dungeon list; no automatic queue or teleport, so players still travel to the entrance.
Dungeon loot reworked: unique boss items are blue, hundreds of new drops, combined hit/crit stats, shared appearances for eligible looters.
Reported XP change: dungeon quests give about 50% less bonus XP, and kills inside dungeons give more (+20% to +50% reported across beta hotfixes).
Shadowfang Keep: Fenrus summons Voidwalkers at 50% health, Nandos summons worgs, and Arugal's table book gives the Black Tome that leads to a secret boss in City of Dalaran.
Maraudon hotfix (Nov 6): Zaetar's Spirit now spawns correctly after Princess Theradras dies.
Blizzard has published no official level table for the Classic dungeons in Forever; ranges here are Classic ranges from Wowhead.

launch.finding: WoW: Forever is Blizzard's official Classic+ (launched November 2026) with 1,000+ new quests, new zones (Mount Hyjal, Shen'dralas, the Riverglades, Zephras Isle) and nine new dungeons.

wowForever.classicQuestCaveat: Classic dungeon quests here are verified against Classic Era data only. Fan sites report Forever lowered many dungeon quest rewards to Uncommon and halved dungeon-quest bonus XP, so rewards and XP may differ in game.
